{{Vanilla}}

{{Infobox auto}}

'''Cake''' is a placeable food. Each slice eaten heals the player instantly and raises their maximum health for 3 minutes.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/cake_eaten.mcfunction}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Crafting ===
{{Recipes}}
The pack's recipe uses 2 [[Sweet Berries|sweet berries]], a [[Milk Bottle|milk bottle]], 2 sugar, an [[egg]] and 3 [[flour]].<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/cake.json}}</ref> Obtaining flour unlocks it. The vanilla recipe is removed. Crafting it returns the milk bottle's glass bottle.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Cake is placed and eaten a slice at a time, as in vanilla. Each tick, the pack checks every player's cake-slice statistic; after a slice, the player gets Instant Health I and {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} II (4 extra hearts of maximum health) for 3:00.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/function/mechanics/cake_eaten.mcfunction}}</ref> Instant Health I heals {{Hp|4}}, but the item's tooltip shows 4 hearts ({{Hp|8}}).
